title: Qman DirectPath portable operation payload profiles
description: Closed, backend-neutral request and result payload profiles for all 35 frozen DirectPath operations. These profiles define the portable wire semantics without assuming private Qman service names, database tables, or source-tree fields.
x-qmanInteroperableIntegerRange: Every JSON numeric integer is in -9007199254740991..9007199254740991; wider unsigned counters and address quantities use canonicalDecimal strings.
x-envelopeBindingRule: The enclosing directpath-operation-envelope operationId and envelopeKind MUST equal this payload's operationId and direction; payloadSchemaAuthority MUST be PORTABLE_CONTRACT; payloadSchemaRef MUST equal the indexed canonical fragment; payloadSchemaSha256 binds the Git blob bytes of this complete schema; payloadHash is SHA-256(CANONICAL-JSON-V1(payload)).
x-operationLeaseBindingRule: Every operationLeaseBinding or releaseOperationLeaseBinding is an exact projection of the enclosing envelope operationLeaseCapabilityOrNull for operationLeaseId, leaseType, scopeHash, holderControllerGeneration, operationLeaseResourceVersion, and admissionBindingHashOrNull. ASSIGNMENT_PREPARE requires the exact non-null immutable OperationAdmissionBinding bindingHash stored on the live OperationLease; every other current lease type requires null. capabilityHash binds the complete enclosing sealed capability and does not replace field equality.
x-resultBindingRule: Envelope status/retryable/reason and committed authority fields MUST be an exact projection of body.outcome, body.errorOrNull, and body.casResult. A CONFLICT has at least one typed CAS conflict and no output; a failed result cannot masquerade as a successful operation-specific output.
x-referenceRule: entityRef binds an authority aggregate identity/version/generation/content hash. documentRef binds a backend-neutral semantic document kind, schema reference, version, and canonical content hash. A target mapping may choose storage and RPC layout but may not weaken or relabel these semantics.

canonicalDecimal.$comment: Used where the portable domain may exceed JSON's exact interoperable integer range.

snapshotPublicationAuthorityConflict.x-qmanPublicationConflictRule: Each conflict identifies one failed compare from the exact four-authority publication expectation. No device row, snapshot row, audit row, outbox row or caller-selected entity may be reported as a publication authority conflict.

snapshotPublicationCasResult.x-qmanTraceBindingRule: This compact result never attempts to serialize repository INSERTs as generic casMutation objects. For COMMITTED/NO_CHANGE, expectationHashOrNull, committedAuthorityHashOrNull, every expected/committed version, both capability/freshness policy hashes, mutationSetHashOrNull, commitRecordDigestOrNull and publicationMutationCount exact-project the retained host-snapshot publication trace; expectationHashOrNull and committedAuthorityHashOrNull are non-null for both outcomes, including the read-only NO_CHANGE authority snapshot. COMMITTED publicationMutationCount equals the complete DeviceRecord count plus six fixed rows. CONFLICT carries only failed HostAuthority, AvailabilityAuthority, CapabilityPolicyAuthority and/or HostSnapshotFreshnessPolicyAuthority compares, at most four.

snapshotFreshnessDecisionResult.x-qmanTraceBindingRule: The complete object exact-projects directpath-host-snapshot-publication-trace.freshnessDecision byte-for-byte. evaluationDisposition, both age thresholds, both nullable evidence bases, refreshRequired and decisionDigest are retained together; a policy document ref or digest alone is not a freshness-decision result.

bundleSummaries.x-qmanSetOrder: ascending CANONICAL-JSON-V1 bytes of [bundleId]; duplicate bundleId values are rejected

leaseSummaries.x-qmanSetOrder: ascending CANONICAL-JSON-V1 bytes of [bundleId,leaseId]; duplicate leaseId values are rejected

reasons.x-qmanSetOrder: ascending CANONICAL-JSON-V1 bytes of [code,stage,devices,details,provenance]; duplicate complete reasons are rejected

evidenceRefs.x-qmanSetOrder: ascending CANONICAL-JSON-V1 bytes of [documentKind,documentId,documentVersion,contentHash]; duplicate [documentKind,documentId,documentVersion] keys are rejected

output_OP_QUERY_DIRECTPATH.x-qmanDeterministicOutputRule: For one stable authenticated request projection and one byte-identical QueryReadTrace read state, every field and all four canonical arrays are byte-identical. capabilityDecisionHash and semanticDependencyHash bind the guarded evaluator result; queryStateHash equals the before/after stateDigest in the correlated raw QueryReadTrace. The output intentionally carries no traceDigest, trace timestamp, or repository transaction ID, avoiding an output/trace hash fixed point.

requestBody_OP_CAPTURE_HOST_SNAPSHOT.x-qmanPublicationReadSetBindingRule: The request exact-projects one coherent retained publication read set. currentHostAuthority={entityType:ENTITY-HOST-AUTHORITY,entityId:hostAuthorityBefore.state.hostId,resourceVersion:hostAuthorityBefore.state.resourceVersion,generationOrNull:hostAuthorityBefore.state.agentGeneration,contentHash:hostAuthorityBefore.instanceBytesSha256}. currentAvailabilityAuthority={entityType:ENTITY-AVAILABILITY-AUTHORITY,entityId:availabilityAuthorityBefore.state.availabilityAuthorityId,resourceVersion:availabilityAuthorityBefore.state.resourceVersion,generationOrNull:null,contentHash:availabilityAuthorityBefore.instanceBytesSha256}. capabilityPolicy={documentKind:CAPABILITY_POLICY,documentId:capabilityPolicy.state.policyId,documentVersion:capabilityPolicy.state.policyVersion,canonicalProfile:CANONICAL-JSON-V1,schemaRef:contracts/directpath-capability-policy.schema.json,contentHash:capabilityPolicy.instanceBytesSha256}. capabilityPolicyAuthority={entityType:ENTITY-CAPABILITY-POLICY-AUTHORITY,entityId:capabilityPolicyAuthority.state.policyAuthorityId,resourceVersion:capabilityPolicyAuthority.state.resourceVersion,generationOrNull:null,contentHash:capabilityPolicyAuthority.instanceBytesSha256}. snapshotFreshnessPolicy={documentKind:HOST_SNAPSHOT_FRESHNESS_POLICY,documentId:freshnessPolicy.state.policyId,documentVersion:freshnessPolicy.state.policyVersion,canonicalProfile:CANONICAL-JSON-V1,schemaRef:contracts/directpath-host-snapshot-publication-trace.schema.json#/$defs/freshnessPolicy,contentHash:freshnessPolicy.instanceBytesSha256}. snapshotFreshnessPolicyAuthority={entityType:ENTITY-HOST-SNAPSHOT-FRESHNESS-POLICY-AUTHORITY,entityId:freshnessPolicyAuthority.state.freshnessPolicyAuthorityId,resourceVersion:freshnessPolicyAuthority.state.resourceVersion,generationOrNull:null,contentHash:freshnessPolicyAuthority.instanceBytesSha256}. For GENESIS_COMMITTED, hostSnapshotRollbackAnchorOrNull and hostSnapshotAnchorFreshnessOrNull are both null. Otherwise hostSnapshotRollbackAnchorOrNull={documentKind:HOST_SNAPSHOT_ROLLBACK_ANCHOR,documentId:snapshotRollbackAuthority.beforeOrNull.state.anchorDigest,documentVersion:snapshotRollbackAuthority.beforeOrNull.state.anchorVersion,canonicalProfile:CANONICAL-JSON-V1,schemaRef:contracts/directpath-host-snapshot-rollback-anchor.schema.json,contentHash:snapshotRollbackAuthority.beforeOrNull.instanceBytesSha256} and hostSnapshotAnchorFreshnessOrNull={documentKind:ANCHOR_FRESHNESS_ENVELOPE,documentId:snapshotRollbackAuthority.beforeFreshnessOrNull.state.envelopeId,documentVersion:snapshotRollbackAuthority.beforeFreshnessOrNull.state.resourceVersion,canonicalProfile:CANONICAL-JSON-V1,schemaRef:contracts/directpath-anchor-freshness-envelope.schema.json,contentHash:snapshotRollbackAuthority.beforeFreshnessOrNull.instanceBytesSha256}; both project the pre-decision artifacts, never the after artifacts. The SERIALIZABLE transaction compares all four authority versions, both policy hashes and the exact retained policy bytes; policy fields, thresholds and mandatory selectors are never accepted as open request values.

output_OP_CAPTURE_HOST_SNAPSHOT.x-qmanPublicationTraceProjectionRule: For OP-CAPTURE success, every field is a deterministic projection of actual canonical artifacts retained in directpath-host-snapshot-publication-trace.schema.json. hostSnapshot={documentKind:HOST_SNAPSHOT,documentId:hostSnapshotAfter.state.contentHash,documentVersion:hostSnapshotAfter.state.snapshotEpoch,canonicalProfile:CANONICAL-JSON-V1,schemaRef:contracts/directpath-portable-hash-subjects.schema.json#/$defs/hostSnapshot,contentHash:hostSnapshotAfter.instanceBytesSha256}; snapshotContentHash=hostSnapshotAfter.state.contentHash. inventorySignature identifies those same signed hostSnapshotAfter bytes with documentKind=HOST_INVENTORY_SIGNATURE, documentId=hostSnapshotAfter.state.contentHash, documentVersion=hostSnapshotAfter.state.keyRingVersion, the same schemaRef and contentHash. advancedHostAuthority={entityType:ENTITY-HOST-AUTHORITY,entityId:hostAuthorityAfter.state.hostId,resourceVersion:hostAuthorityAfter.state.resourceVersion,generationOrNull:hostAuthorityAfter.state.agentGeneration,contentHash:hostAuthorityAfter.instanceBytesSha256}. factProvenanceSetHash=captureBatch.instance.providerSemanticProjection.providerFactsDigest. freshnessDecision exact-projects the complete trace.freshnessDecision object byte-for-byte, including evaluationDisposition and decisionDigest. snapshotRollbackAnchor={documentKind:HOST_SNAPSHOT_ROLLBACK_ANCHOR,documentId:snapshotRollbackAuthority.after.state.anchorDigest,documentVersion:snapshotRollbackAuthority.after.state.anchorVersion,canonicalProfile:CANONICAL-JSON-V1,schemaRef:contracts/directpath-host-snapshot-rollback-anchor.schema.json,contentHash:snapshotRollbackAuthority.after.instanceBytesSha256}. snapshotAnchorFreshness={documentKind:ANCHOR_FRESHNESS_ENVELOPE,documentId:snapshotRollbackAuthority.afterFreshness.state.envelopeId,documentVersion:snapshotRollbackAuthority.afterFreshness.state.resourceVersion,canonicalProfile:CANONICAL-JSON-V1,schemaRef:contracts/directpath-anchor-freshness-envelope.schema.json,contentHash:snapshotRollbackAuthority.afterFreshness.instanceBytesSha256}. A ref label or digest without the actual retained bytes is invalid.

requestBody_OP_STORE_IDEMPOTENT_RESULT.x-qmanNaturalKeyRule: [operationId,idempotencyScopeHash,idempotencyKey] is byte-equal to the original accepted REQUEST envelope tuple whose requestHash and runId are being stored; operationId identifies that original operation and is not the enclosing OP-STORE-IDEMPOTENT-RESULT operationId.

x-qmanCaptureHostSnapshotTrustReferenceR: trustedKeyRing exact-projects the publication VerifiedTrustContext current ring as {documentKind:TRUST_KEY_RING,documentId:keyRingId,documentVersion:keyRingSequence,canonicalProfile:CANONICAL-JSON-V1,schemaRef:contracts/directpath-trust-key-ring.schema.json,contentHash:SHA-256 of the exact verified current key-ring canonical bytes}; keyRingDigest alone is not the exact document-byte hash

trustRootSet exact-projects the same VerifiedTrustContext pinned root as {documentKind:TRUST_ROOT_SET,documentId:rootSetId,documentVersion:1,canonicalProfile:CANONICAL-JSON-V1,schemaRef:contracts/directpath-trust-root-set.schema.json,contentHash:SHA-256 of the exact verified root-set canonical bytes}

rollbackAnchor exact-projects the same VerifiedTrustContext external anchor as {documentKind:TRUST_ROLLBACK_ANCHOR,documentId:trustAnchorDigest,documentVersion:trustAnchorVersion,canonicalProfile:CANONICAL-JSON-V1,schemaRef:contracts/directpath-trust-rollback-anchor.schema.json,contentHash:SHA-256 of the exact verified anchor canonical bytes}; the trust context must be live at request issuedAt
